_meta.what: Descriptive flip matrix for #2329: reliability.detection_strength = the weak|moderate|strong ordinal projected from a detection/abundance property's own detection datum, over the framework's committed measured observations. The cutpoints are each scheme's method's OWN detection cuts (single-sourced). detection_strength is verdict-inert (SK#2091) and OPTIONAL (omitted below the detection floor).
_meta.ground_truth: MEASURED/STORED: the observed detection datum per committed unit (the upstream class token / the numeric fraction). DERIVED (re-computed in the test, never trusted from here): detection_strength, via the SAME detection_strength_for the deriver uses. The cuts are re-read from each method's constant/classifier both directions, never stored.
